proposed_composition.reply:
For most people, Medicare first becomes available around age 65. The usual first sign-up window is 7 months long: the 3 months before your 65th birthday month, your birthday month, and the 3 months after. That said, when coverage can start is not always the same as when you enroll, and current health insurance can affect which timing rules matter. If someone qualifies earlier because of disability, ALS, or End-Stage Renal Disease, different rules can apply.

So the most helpful next detail is what health insurance you have now, because that changes how to think about timing.
